Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, a unit of Kongsberg Gruppen
, won a $404.4M U.S. defense IDIQ contract for Naval Strike Missile launcher units, weapon control systems, and related support equipment.
The contract covers full-rate production and sustainment support through Sept. 24, 2034.
No funds were committed at award, while payments will be made through individual delivery and task orders as they are issued.
Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Marine Corps, is the contracting activity.

title: Kongsberg Gruppen boosts U.S. defense push with $404M missile deal
